s1.desc: a dim bedroom drawn on a plain grey background

spans.view: with a wooden bed with a duck-shaped bedpost, and {ifin} lying screen-down on the covers beside her

beats.text: Polly lies on her side under the covers with her head on the pillow and a flipper tucked under her cheek, eyes closed
Polly snaps her eyes wide open and stares ahead, lying still on the pillow
Polly shuts her eyes again and lies motionless with her cheek resting on her flipper
Polly opens her eyes wide once more and stares blankly ahead from the pillow
Polly closes her eyes again, still lying on her side under the covers
Polly pops her eyes open yet again and gazes ahead, wide awake
Polly closes her eyes one more time, lying still on the pillow
